---
title: "linear_features_ssf_kaza"
author: "Rachel Frost"
date: "2026-11-05"
output: html_document
---

Adds fence, road, and river crossing indicators to the KAZA seasonal SSF (no movement
terms, per team decision Nov 1 2026), with the same tests as the Etosha and West scripts:

1. step-length robustness check (refit with `sl_ + log_sl_`)
2. three scenarios: distance-to only / distance-to + crossings / crossings replace distance-to
3. how every coefficient shifts when crossings or step length are added

Starts from the saved 1-hr KAZA extractions (`ele_trk_extract_kaza_wet.rds`,
`ele_trk_extract_kaza_dry.rds`), which already have the `_linear` columns from
`extract_linear()`, so no re-extraction is needed for crossings.

Differences from the West script:

- KAZA comes as two seasonal files, so each season is prepped and fit separately (never bound
  together, which saves memory).
- KAZA's land cover has not had the Oct 21 `extract_lc_mixed()` rerun yet. `lc_mode` picks
  binary land cover if present and otherwise falls back to the `_dist` versions. Results with
  `_dist` land cover are fine for the crossing questions but their habitat terms are not
  directly comparable to Etosha/West.
- River crossings are included: KAZA's rivers are perennial and inside the river layer's
  extent (all steps 20.0–25.0°E; layer runs to 25.5°E).
- Crossing terms with too few used crossings are dropped automatically (`min_used_cross`).
- Fits are cached with a signature (formulas + row counts); if you change settings, the cache
  is detected as stale and refit instead of silently reloaded.

```{r setup}
library(tidyverse)
library(here)
library(amt)
library(survival)
select <- dplyr::select
```

## 0. Settings

```{r settings}
lc_mode        <- "auto"   # "auto" (binary if present, else _dist), "binary", or "dist"
drop_water     <- FALSE    # TRUE also drops water_rivers_dist in scenario 3
min_used_cross <- 30       # crossing terms with fewer used crossings in either season are dropped
```

## 0b. Optional: test whether the binary land cover rasters cover KAZA

Run this once before deciding on `extract_lc_mixed()` for KAZA. If the binary layers were
clipped to Namibia's western/central extent, many KAZA endpoints come back NA. Not evaluated
when knitting.

```{r}
for (s in c("wet", "dry")) {
  out <- here("outputs", paste0("ele_trk_extract_kaza_", s, "_lcmixed.rds"))
  if (file.exists(out)) { cat(s, "already done\n"); next }

  d  <- readRDS(here("outputs", paste0("ele_trk_extract_kaza_", s, ".rds")))
  n0 <- nrow(d)

  d <- d |>
    select(-any_of(c("cropland_dist", "urban_dist", "water_rivers_dist"))) |>  # re-extracted (identical)
    extract_lc_mixed()

  stopifnot(nrow(d) == n0)                                                      # no rows lost
  cat(s, "rows:", nrow(d), "| binary NAs:",
      colSums(is.na(d[, c("grassland", "shrubland", "tree_cover")])), "\n")
  saveRDS(d, out)
  rm(d); gc()
}
```


```{r lc-coverage-test, eval = FALSE}
kaza_test <- readRDS(here("outputs", "ele_trk_extract_kaza_wet.rds")) |> slice_sample(n = 5000)
kaza_test <- extract_lc_mixed(kaza_test)   # same call as the Etosha/West pipeline
colSums(is.na(kaza_test[, c("grassland", "shrubland", "tree_cover")]))   # should be ~0
range(kaza_test$x2_); range(kaza_test$y2_)
rm(kaza_test); gc()
```

## 1. Load extracted steps

```{r load}
kaza_files <- c(wet = "ele_trk_extract_kaza_wet_lcmixed.rds",
                dry = "ele_trk_extract_kaza_dry_lcmixed.rds")

kaza_raw <- imap(kaza_files, ~ readRDS(here("outputs", .x)) |> mutate(season = .y))
map_int(kaza_raw, nrow)   # wet: 4,968,821
```

## 2. Checks before prep

Every line here should pass before fitting anything.

```{r checks}
# --- 1-hr steps, step lengths, extent ---
check_season <- function(d, s) {
  obs <- d |> filter(case_)
  dt  <- as.numeric(difftime(obs$t2_, obs$t1_, units = "mins"))
  tibble(season = s, rows = nrow(d), used = nrow(obs),
         median_dt_min = median(dt, na.rm = TRUE),
         pct_dt_45_75  = mean(between(dt, 45, 75), na.rm = TRUE),   # should be near 1
         sl_na = sum(is.na(d$sl_)), sl_le0 = sum(d$sl_ <= 0, na.rm = TRUE),
         sl_median = median(d$sl_, na.rm = TRUE),   # < ~0.1 = degrees; hundreds = meters
         x2_min = min(d$x2_, na.rm = TRUE), x2_max = max(d$x2_, na.rm = TRUE))
}
imap_dfr(kaza_raw, check_season)

# --- columns ---
lin_cols  <- c("kaza_vet_fences_linear", "roads_linear", "hydrorivers_linear")
dist_lin  <- c("fence_dist", "road_dist", "water_rivers_dist")
hab_terms <- c("cropland_dist", "urban_dist", "elevation", "slope", "aspect", "evi", "world_pop")
lc_binary <- c("grassland", "shrubland", "tree_cover")
lc_dist   <- paste0(lc_binary, "_dist")

nm <- Reduce(intersect, map(kaza_raw, names))   # columns present in BOTH seasons

lc_terms <- switch(lc_mode,
                   binary = lc_binary,
                   dist   = lc_dist,
                   auto   = if (all(lc_binary %in% nm)) lc_binary else lc_dist)
cat("Land cover terms:", lc_terms, "\n")
if (identical(lc_terms, lc_dist)) {
  message("Using distance-to land cover (no extract_lc_mixed() rerun yet). ",
          "Crossing results are fine; habitat terms are not directly comparable to Etosha/West.")
}

needed  <- c("id", "step_id_", "case_", "sl_", "t1_", "t2_",
             lin_cols, dist_lin, hab_terms, lc_terms)
missing <- setdiff(needed, nm)
if (length(missing)) stop("Missing columns: ", paste(missing, collapse = ", "))

# --- step IDs: already prefixed with the elephant id? ---
map(kaza_raw, ~ head(.x$step_id_))

# --- NAs in land cover (binary NAs are about to become 0 = "not this class") ---
map(kaza_raw, ~ colSums(is.na(.x[, lc_terms])))
```

## 3. Prep: step IDs, crossing indicators, land cover NAs

Crossing columns come from `extract_linear()`: the max of each 500m line raster along the
step, so "crossed" = the step passed through a cell containing the feature. The river layer is
binary (1 = mapped river cell; mean discharge ≥ 10 m³/s).

```{r prep}
prep_season <- function(d) {
  # only prefix step_id_ if it isn't already unique across elephants
  prefixed <- all(str_starts(as.character(d$step_id_), paste0(d$id, "_")))

  d <- d |>
    mutate(
      step_id_ = if (prefixed) as.character(step_id_) else paste(id, step_id_, sep = "_"),
      across(all_of(lin_cols), ~ replace(.x, is.infinite(.x) | is.na(.x), 0)),  # -Inf/NA = no feature (works for int or double)
      fence_cross = as.integer(kaza_vet_fences_linear > 0),
      road_cross  = as.integer(roads_linear > 0),
      river_cross = as.integer(hydrorivers_linear > 0)    # 1 = mapped river cell
    ) |>
    filter(!is.na(sl_), sl_ > 0)                          # log_sl_ must be finite

  if (identical(lc_terms, lc_binary)) {
    d <- d |> mutate(across(all_of(lc_binary), ~ replace_na(.x, 0)))
  }
  d
}

kaza <- map(kaza_raw, prep_season)
rm(kaza_raw); gc()

# checkpoint: strata intact (each step_id_ has exactly 1 used step)
iwalk(kaza, function(d, s) {
  sc <- d |> group_by(step_id_) |> summarise(n_case = sum(case_), n = n(), .groups = "drop")
  cat("\n", s, "- strata:", nrow(sc), "\n")
  print(table(sc$n_case))   # all 1s
  print(summary(sc$n))      # mostly 11
})
```

## 3b. Crossing counts: which crossing terms can be estimated?

```{r crossing-counts}
cross_all <- c("fence_cross", "road_cross", "river_cross")

used_cross <- imap_dfr(kaza, ~ .x |> filter(case_) |>
                         summarise(across(all_of(cross_all), sum), n_used = n()) |>
                         mutate(season = .y, .before = 1))
used_cross

avail_cross <- imap_dfr(kaza, ~ .x |> filter(!case_) |>
                          summarise(across(all_of(cross_all), sum), n_avail = n()) |>
                          mutate(season = .y, .before = 1))
avail_cross

cross_terms <- cross_all[map_lgl(cross_all, ~ min(used_cross[[.x]]) >= min_used_cross)]
cat("Crossing terms used:", cross_terms, "\n")
dropped <- setdiff(cross_all, cross_terms)
if (length(dropped)) message("Dropped (< ", min_used_cross, " used crossings in a season): ",
                             paste(dropped, collapse = ", "))

# overlap between each crossing indicator and its distance-to term (available steps)
imap_dfr(kaza, ~ .x |> filter(!case_) |>
           summarise(fence = cor(fence_cross, fence_dist),
                     road  = cor(road_cross, road_dist),
                     river_vs_water = cor(river_cross, water_rivers_dist)) |>
           mutate(season = .y, .before = 1))
```

## 3c. Save prepped steps (for BCI)

`outputs/` is gitignored and the files are large; share via the team drive, not git. List
columns (raw along-step values) are dropped; the summarized columns already exist. File names
say `_lcdist` if the land cover is still distance-to.

```{r save-linecross}
iwalk(kaza, function(d, s) {
  p <- here("outputs", paste0("ele_trk_extract_kaza_", s, "_linecross",
                              if (identical(lc_terms, lc_dist)) "_lcdist", ".rds"))
  if (!file.exists(p)) {
    d |> select(-any_of(c("terrain_list", "linear_list"))) |> saveRDS(p)
  }
})
```

## 4. Formulas and model data

Every model below is fit on the same NA-filtered rows per season, so AIC/BIC are comparable
across all scenarios and the step-length check.

```{r formulas}
make_f <- function(terms) reformulate(c(terms, "strata(step_id_)"), response = "case_")

main_terms <- c(dist_lin, hab_terms, lc_terms, cross_terms)

# scenario 3: each crossing term replaces its own distance-to term;
# river_cross has no pair (water_rivers_dist is land-cover water, kept unless drop_water)
pairs            <- c(fence_cross = "fence_dist", road_cross = "road_dist")
replaced         <- unname(pairs[intersect(names(pairs), cross_terms)])
cross_only_terms <- setdiff(main_terms, c(replaced, if (drop_water) "water_rivers_dist"))

f_main       <- make_f(main_terms)                              # 2. distance-to + crossings
f_slcheck    <- make_f(c(main_terms, "sl_", "log_sl_"))         # robustness check
f_base       <- make_f(c(dist_lin, hab_terms, lc_terms))        # 1. distance-to only
f_cross_only <- make_f(cross_only_terms)                        # 3. crossings replace distance-to

f_main
f_cross_only

model_vars <- unique(c(main_terms, "sl_", "case_", "step_id_"))
kaza_model_dat <- map(kaza, ~ .x |> drop_na(all_of(model_vars)) |> mutate(log_sl_ = log(sl_)))

# checkpoint: rows dropped by the NA filter (should be 0 or very few)
map2_int(kaza, kaza_model_dat, ~ nrow(.x) - nrow(.y))

rm(kaza); gc()
```

## 5. Fit (cached)

Four models per season on ~4–5M rows each, so this takes a while. The cache stores a
signature (formulas, settings, row counts); if any of those change, it refits instead of
loading stale fits.

```{r fit}
fit_sig <- list(formulas   = map_chr(list(f_main, f_slcheck, f_base, f_cross_only),
                                     ~ paste(deparse(.x), collapse = "")),
                lc_terms   = lc_terms,
                drop_water = drop_water,
                n          = map_int(kaza_model_dat, nrow))

cached <- function(path, sig, expr) {
  if (file.exists(path)) {
    obj <- readRDS(path)
    if (identical(obj$sig, sig)) return(obj$value)
    message("Cache is stale (settings or data changed), refitting: ", basename(path))
  }
  value <- expr   # evaluated only here
  saveRDS(list(sig = sig, value = value), path)
  value
}

lc_tag <- if (identical(lc_terms, lc_dist)) "_lcdist" else ""

kaza_fits <- cached(
  here("outputs", paste0("kaza_ssf_crossing_fits", lc_tag, ".rds")), fit_sig,
  map(kaza_model_dat, ~ list(main    = fit_clogit(.x, f_main, model = FALSE),
                             slcheck = fit_clogit(.x, f_slcheck, model = FALSE))))

scen_fits <- cached(
  here("outputs", paste0("kaza_ssf_scenario_fits", lc_tag, if (drop_water) "_nowater", ".rds")),
  fit_sig,
  map(kaza_model_dat, ~ list(base       = fit_clogit(.x, f_base, model = FALSE),
                             cross_only = fit_clogit(.x, f_cross_only, model = FALSE))))

summary(kaza_fits$wet$main)
summary(kaza_fits$dry$main)
```

## 6. Robustness to step length

`shift_over_se` = change in each crossing coefficient when step length is added, in units of
the main model's SE. |shift| < ~2 SE = robust. `sl_` units don't matter here (`log_sl_` only
shifts by a constant and `sl_` rescales its own coefficient), but don't compare `sl_`
coefficients across populations.

```{r robustness}
robustness <- map_dfr(names(kaza_fits), function(s) {
  m  <- summary(kaza_fits[[s]]$main)$coefficients[cross_terms, , drop = FALSE]
  sc <- summary(kaza_fits[[s]]$slcheck)$coefficients[cross_terms, , drop = FALSE]
  tibble(season = s, term = cross_terms,
         coef_main = m[, "coef"], se_main = m[, "se(coef)"],
         rel_sel_main = exp(m[, "coef"]),
         coef_sl = sc[, "coef"],
         shift_over_se = (sc[, "coef"] - m[, "coef"]) / m[, "se(coef)"])
})
robustness
```

## 7. Three scenarios: add vs. replace

```{r scenarios}
scenario_table <- map_dfr(c("wet", "dry"), function(s) {
  mods <- list("1. distance-to only"              = scen_fits[[s]]$base$model,
               "2. distance-to + crossings"       = kaza_fits[[s]]$main$model,
               "3. crossings replace distance-to" = scen_fits[[s]]$cross_only$model)
  stopifnot(n_distinct(map_int(mods, "n")) == 1)    # same rows in all three
  tibble(season = s, scenario = names(mods),
         n   = map_int(mods, "n"),
         k   = map_int(mods, ~ length(coef(.x))),
         AIC = map_dbl(mods, AIC),
         BIC = map_dbl(mods, BIC)) |>
    mutate(dAIC = AIC - min(AIC), dBIC = BIC - min(BIC))
})
scenario_table

# crossing coefficients with vs without the distance-to terms
map_dfr(c("wet", "dry"), ~ tibble(
  season = .x, term = cross_terms,
  with_dist    = coef(kaza_fits[[.x]]$main$model)[cross_terms],
  without_dist = coef(scen_fits[[.x]]$cross_only$model)[cross_terms]))

# step-length check vs main (same rows, so AIC is comparable)
map_dfr(c("wet", "dry"), ~ tibble(
  season = .x, model = c("SSF + crossings", "+ sl_ + log_sl_"),
  AIC = c(AIC(kaza_fits[[.x]]$main$model), AIC(kaza_fits[[.x]]$slcheck$model))) |>
  mutate(dAIC = AIC - min(AIC)))
```

```{r}
#Plot to visualize linear features + movement

library(terra)

# --- sampled used locations (both seasons) ---
kaza_pts <- imap_dfr(kaza_model_dat, ~ .x |> filter(case_) |>
                       slice_sample(n = 15000) |>
                       select(x2_, y2_) |> mutate(season = .y))

# plot window: elephant range + 0.75° buffer, so nearby fences outside the range show up too
bb <- c(xmin = min(kaza_pts$x2_) - 0.75, xmax = max(kaza_pts$x2_) + 0.75,
        ymin = min(kaza_pts$y2_) - 0.75, ymax = max(kaza_pts$y2_) + 0.75)

# --- linear feature cells from the 500 m rasters the model used ---
lin_cells <- function(file, label) {
  r <- rast(here("data", "Linear_features", file))
  e <- project(ext(bb["xmin"], bb["xmax"], bb["ymin"], bb["ymax"]),
               from = "EPSG:4326", to = crs(r))
  df <- r |> crop(e) |> project("EPSG:4326", method = "near") |> as.data.frame(xy = TRUE)
  df <- df[df[[3]] > 0, c("x", "y")]
  cat(label, ":", nrow(df), "cells\n")              # checkpoint
  df |> mutate(feature = label)
}

kaza_lines <- bind_rows(
  lin_cells("roads_linear_500m.tif",           "Road"),
  lin_cells("hydrorivers_linear_500m.tif",     "River"),
  lin_cells("kaza_vet_fences_linear_500m.tif", "Vet fence")
) |>
  mutate(feature = factor(feature, levels = c("Road", "River", "Vet fence")))  # fences drawn last (on top)

# --- plot ---
p_kaza_lin <- ggplot() +
  geom_point(data = kaza_pts, aes(x2_, y2_), colour = "grey55", size = 0.15, alpha = 0.3) +
  geom_point(data = kaza_lines |> arrange(feature),
             aes(x, y, colour = feature), shape = 15, size = 0.35) +
  scale_colour_manual(values = c("Road" = "#E69F00", "River" = "#0072B2", "Vet fence" = "#D7191C"),
                      name = NULL) +
  facet_wrap(~ season, ncol = 1) +
  coord_quickmap(xlim = bb[c("xmin", "xmax")], ylim = bb[c("ymin", "ymax")], expand = FALSE) +
  guides(colour = guide_legend(override.aes = list(size = 3))) +
  labs(title = "KAZA elephant locations and linear features used in the SSF",
       subtitle = "Grey = used steps (15k sample per season); features = 500 m crossing rasters",
       caption = "Used fence crossings: 4 (wet), 8 (dry); random-step fence crossings: 269 (wet), 70 (dry)",
       x = NULL, y = NULL) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(legend.position = "top")

p_kaza_lin

dir.create(here("outputs", "figures"), showWarnings = FALSE)
ggsave(here("outputs", "figures", "kaza_points_linear_features.png"),
       p_kaza_lin, width = 9, height = 10, dpi = 200, bg = "white")
```


## 8. How every coefficient shifts: base → + crossings → + movement terms

Shifts are in units of the main model's SE, so they're comparable across covariates on very
different scales. |shift| > ~2 SE = worth noting.

```{r coef-compare}
coef_compare <- map_dfr(c("wet", "dry"), function(s) {
  b  <- coef(scen_fits[[s]]$base$model)
  m  <- coef(kaza_fits[[s]]$main$model)
  mv <- coef(kaza_fits[[s]]$slcheck$model)
  se <- sqrt(diag(vcov(kaza_fits[[s]]$main$model)))
  terms <- names(m)
  tibble(season = s, term = terms,
         base = b[terms], with_cross = m, with_move = mv[terms], se_main = se,
         shift_cross_se = (m - b[terms]) / se,     # effect of adding crossings
         shift_move_se  = (mv[terms] - m) / se)    # effect of adding movement terms
})

coef_compare |> select(season, term, shift_cross_se, shift_move_se) |>
  arrange(season, desc(abs(shift_cross_se)))
coef_compare |> select(season, term, shift_cross_se, shift_move_se) |>
  arrange(season, desc(abs(shift_move_se)))

# save summary tables for the cross-population comparison
saveRDS(list(scenario_table = scenario_table, robustness = robustness,
             coef_compare = coef_compare, used_cross = used_cross,
             cross_terms = cross_terms, lc_terms = lc_terms),
        here("outputs", paste0("kaza_linear_summary", lc_tag, ".rds")))
```

What this does, one season at a time:

1. Loads the KAZA `lcmixed` steps and checks columns and bad fixes
2. Builds the KAZA ephemeral-river lines (HydroRIVERS, catchment >= 1,000 km2, discharge < 10 m3/s, same rule as West)
3. Makes 500 m distance rasters for the new fences and the ephemeral rivers, then extracts at step endpoints
   (`fence_dist` must be rebuilt: the old one came from the old fence layer)
4. Recounts crossings by **vector intersection** (step line touches feature line) for fences, perennial rivers,
   ephemeral rivers, and roads if a road vector exists
5. Fits the model set, compares by AIC/BIC, reports exp(coef) with 95% CI, and runs the step-length check

Fill in the four paths in the `paths` chunk. Every chunk stops early if something doesn't match expectations.

```{r setup}
here::i_am("code/linear_features_ssf_kaza.Rmd")
library(here)
library(tidyverse)
library(sf)
library(terra)
library(survival)
if (!requireNamespace("sfheaders", quietly = TRUE)) install.packages("sfheaders")
select <- dplyr::select
filter <- dplyr::filter
```

```{r paths}
# ---- FILL THESE IN ----
STEP_FILES <- c(
  wet = here("outputs", "ele_trk_extract_kaza_wet_lcmixed.rds"),
  dry = here("outputs", "ele_trk_extract_kaza_dry_lcmixed.rds")
)
# Marissa's new fences are rasters (500 m). If she can share the vector she rasterized from,
# set FENCE_VEC to it and the fences get true line-intersection crossings like the rivers.
FENCE_RAST   <- here("data", "Linear_features", "all_vet_fences", "vetfences_all_500m.tif")
FENCE_DIST   <- here("data", "Linear_features", "all_vet_fences", "dist_vetfences_500m.tif")
FENCE_VEC    <- NULL
HR_AFRICA    <- here("data", "Linear_features", "HydroRIVERS_v10_af.gdb", "HydroRIVERS_v10_af.gdb")  # nested folder from the zip
HR_LAYER     <- st_layers(HR_AFRICA)$name[1]                                           # HydroRIVERS_v10_af
PERENNIAL    <- here("data", "Linear_features", "hydrorivers_namibia_gte5.shp")       # current river layer (covers KAZA to 25.5E)
ROAD_PATH    <- here("data", "Linear_features", "roads_selected_exported.shp")       # road vector -> line-intersection road crossings
# Not KAZA_vet_fences_exported.shp: that's the OLD fence layer (Sep), the one with almost nothing in KAZA's range
STRATA_COL   <- "step_id"    # your stratum column (the id_step_id paste)
MIN_USED_CROSS <- 50         # minimum used-step crossings per season to estimate a crossing term

stopifnot(all(file.exists(STEP_FILES)), file.exists(FENCE_RAST), file.exists(FENCE_DIST),
          dir.exists(HR_AFRICA), file.exists(PERENNIAL), file.exists(ROAD_PATH))

# KAZA steps are in lon/lat (EPSG:4326), the same as Marissa's fence rasters.
# So her grid is the template; nothing gets reprojected. (hydrorivers_linear_500m.tif is UTM 33S: not used here.)
crs_steps    <- "EPSG:4326"
fence_r      <- rast(FENCE_RAST)
fence_dist_r <- rast(FENCE_DIST)            # metres (max ~311 km)
tmpl         <- fence_r
stopifnot(same.crs(fence_r, crs_steps), compareGeom(fence_r, fence_dist_r, stopOnError = FALSE))
print(freq(fence_r))                        # 1 = fence, 0 = not

# Line-on-line intersection in degrees: planar (GEOS) is fine for 1-hr steps and much faster than s2
sf_use_s2(FALSE)
```

## Helpers

```{r helpers}
# clean_names() may have stripped amt's trailing underscores, so look for either version
pick_col <- function(d, opts) {
  hit <- intersect(opts, names(d))
  if (length(hit) == 0) stop("None of these columns found: ", paste(opts, collapse = ", "))
  hit[1]
}

standardize_cols <- function(d) {
  map <- c(x1_ = pick_col(d, c("x1_", "x1")), y1_ = pick_col(d, c("y1_", "y1")),
           x2_ = pick_col(d, c("x2_", "x2")), y2_ = pick_col(d, c("y2_", "y2")),
           case_ = pick_col(d, c("case_", "case")), sl_ = pick_col(d, c("sl_", "sl")))
  # coordinates are degrees, so amt's sl_ is in degrees too. Step length in metres (good approximation at 1-hr steps):
  d |> rename(any_of(setNames(map, names(map)))) |>
    mutate(sl_m = sqrt(((x2_ - x1_) * 111320 * cos((y1_ + y2_) / 2 * pi / 180))^2 +
                       ((y2_ - y1_) * 110574)^2),
           log_sl_m = log(pmax(sl_m, 1)))
}

# Step lines in batches -> TRUE if the step line intersects any feature line
cross_vec <- function(d, lines, batch = 250000) {
  out <- logical(nrow(d))
  idx <- split(seq_len(nrow(d)), ceiling(seq_len(nrow(d)) / batch))
  for (i in seq_along(idx)) {
    ii <- idx[[i]]
    ok <- ii[d$sl_[ii] > 0 & !is.na(d$x2_[ii])]   # zero-length / NA steps can't cross
    if (length(ok)) {
      df <- tibble(id = rep(seq_along(ok), each = 2),
                   x  = as.vector(rbind(d$x1_[ok], d$x2_[ok])),
                   y  = as.vector(rbind(d$y1_[ok], d$y2_[ok])))
      sl <- sfheaders::sf_linestring(df, x = "x", y = "y", linestring_id = "id") |>
        st_set_crs(st_crs(lines))
      out[ok] <- lengths(st_intersects(sl, lines)) > 0
    }
    cat(sprintf("  batch %d/%d done\n", i, length(idx)))
  }
  as.integer(out)
}

# Raster version of a crossing, for when there's no fence vector.
# any    = step line passes through a fence cell (what the old 500 m method did; blends proximity)
# strict = passes through a fence cell AND neither endpoint is in a fence cell
#          (removes steps that end on, or walk along, the fence; can miss real crossings that end right past it)
cross_rast <- function(d, r, batch = 250000) {
  is_fence <- function(v) !is.na(v) & v > 0
  any_ <- logical(nrow(d))
  idx <- split(seq_len(nrow(d)), ceiling(seq_len(nrow(d)) / batch))
  for (i in seq_along(idx)) {
    ii <- idx[[i]]
    ok <- ii[d$sl_[ii] > 0 & !is.na(d$x2_[ii])]
    if (length(ok)) {
      df <- tibble(id = rep(seq_along(ok), each = 2),
                   x  = as.vector(rbind(d$x1_[ok], d$x2_[ok])),
                   y  = as.vector(rbind(d$y1_[ok], d$y2_[ok])))
      sl <- sfheaders::sf_linestring(df, x = "x", y = "y", linestring_id = "id") |>
        st_set_crs(st_crs(crs_steps))
      e <- terra::extract(r, vect(sl), fun = max, na.rm = TRUE)
      any_[ok] <- is_fence(e[, 2])
    }
    cat(sprintf("  batch %d/%d done\n", i, length(idx)))
  }
  start_in <- is_fence(terra::extract(r, cbind(d$x1_, d$y1_))[, 1])
  end_in   <- is_fence(terra::extract(r, cbind(d$x2_, d$y2_))[, 1])
  tibble(any = as.integer(any_), strict = as.integer(any_ & !start_in & !end_in))
}

# Rasterize lines on the 500 m template, then distance (m) to nearest line cell
dist_raster <- function(lines) {
  r <- rasterize(vect(lines), tmpl, touches = TRUE)
  distance(r)
}

prep_lines <- function(x, bbox_sf) {
  x |> st_zm() |> st_transform(crs_steps) |>
    st_filter(bbox_sf) |> select(any_of(c("HYRIV_ID", "UPLAND_SKM", "DIS_AV_CMS")))
}
```

## Checkpoint 1: steps load, columns, bad fixes

Load one file at a time (both at once crashed R last time).

```{r check-steps}
bb_all <- NULL
for (s in names(STEP_FILES)) {
  d <- readRDS(STEP_FILES[[s]]) |> standardize_cols()
  stopifnot(STRATA_COL %in% names(d))
  cat("\n==", s, "==  rows:", nrow(d), " strata:", n_distinct(d[[STRATA_COL]]), "\n")
  print(table(d$case_))

  # Bad fixes: used 1-hr steps > 8 km. MET23/MET42 caused West's wet-season artifact.
  cat("sl_ range (degrees?):", round(range(d$sl_, na.rm = TRUE), 4), "  sl_m median (m):", round(median(d$sl_m[d$case_ == 1], na.rm = TRUE)), "\n")
  bad <- d |> filter(case_ == 1, sl_m > 8000)
  cat("Used steps > 8 km:", nrow(bad), "\n")
  if (nrow(bad) > 0 && "id" %in% names(d)) print(count(bad, id, sort = TRUE))
  if (any(c("MET23", "MET42") %in% d$id)) warning("MET23/MET42 present in KAZA ", s, ": inspect before fitting")

  bb_s <- st_as_sfc(st_bbox(c(xmin = min(d$x2_, na.rm = TRUE), ymin = min(d$y2_, na.rm = TRUE),
                              xmax = max(d$x2_, na.rm = TRUE), ymax = max(d$y2_, na.rm = TRUE)),
                            crs = st_crs(crs_steps)))
  bb_all <- if (is.null(bb_all)) bb_s else st_union(bb_all, bb_s)
  rm(d); gc()
}
b <- st_bbox(bb_all)
bb_kaza <- st_as_sfc(st_bbox(c(xmin = b[["xmin"]] - 0.2, ymin = b[["ymin"]] - 0.2,
                               xmax = b[["xmax"]] + 0.2, ymax = b[["ymax"]] + 0.2),
                             crs = st_crs(crs_steps)))   # ~20 km margin
```

**Stop here if** there are many > 8 km used steps concentrated in one or two collars. Drop those fixes and regenerate steps before going on.

## Build the feature lines

```{r lines}
fences    <- if (!is.null(FENCE_VEC)) st_read(FENCE_VEC, quiet = TRUE) |> prep_lines(bb_kaza) else NULL
perennial <- st_read(PERENNIAL,  quiet = TRUE) |> prep_lines(bb_kaza)

# Ephemeral rivers: same rule as West and the earlier maps.
# If read_hr() is loaded, this matches the Etosha/KAZA check exactly
# (bb_kaza_hr = the bbox object you passed to read_hr() before).
if (exists("read_hr") && exists("bb_kaza_hr")) {
  ephemeral <- read_hr(bb_kaza_hr, min_upland = 1000) |>
    filter(DIS_AV_CMS < 10) |> prep_lines(bb_kaza)
} else {
  bb_ll <- st_as_text(st_transform(bb_kaza, 4326))
  ephemeral <- st_read(HR_AFRICA, layer = HR_LAYER, wkt_filter = bb_ll, quiet = TRUE) |>
    filter(UPLAND_SKM >= 1000, DIS_AV_CMS < 10) |> prep_lines(bb_kaza)
}
roads <- if (!is.null(ROAD_PATH)) st_read(ROAD_PATH, quiet = TRUE) |> prep_lines(bb_kaza) else NULL

fence_cells_kaza <- global(crop(fence_r, vect(bb_kaza)) > 0, "sum", na.rm = TRUE)[1, 1]
cat("Fence cells in KAZA extent:", fence_cells_kaza, " fence vector:", if (is.null(fences)) "none (raster crossings)" else nrow(fences),
    " perennial:", nrow(perennial), " ephemeral:", nrow(ephemeral),
    " roads:", if (is.null(roads)) "raster kept" else nrow(roads), "\n")
stopifnot(fence_cells_kaza > 0, nrow(ephemeral) > 0)

st_write(ephemeral, here("data", "Linear_features", "kaza_ephemeral_rivers_hydrorivers_1k.gpkg"),
         delete_dsn = TRUE, quiet = TRUE)
```

## Distance rasters and extraction

```{r dist-rasters}
# fence_dist_r comes straight from Marissa's dist_vetfences_500m.tif (loaded in `paths`)
eph_dist_r   <- dist_raster(ephemeral)
writeRaster(eph_dist_r,  here("data", "Linear_features", "kaza_ephemeral_rivers_dist_1k_500m.tif"), overwrite = TRUE)
```

```{r extract}
for (s in names(STEP_FILES)) {
  cat("\n==", s, "==\n")
  d <- readRDS(STEP_FILES[[s]]) |> standardize_cols()
  xy <- cbind(d$x2_, d$y2_)

  # keep the old raster-based values for comparison
  d <- d |> rename(any_of(c(fence_dist_old = "fence_dist", fence_cross_r500 = "fence_cross",
                            river_cross_r500 = "river_cross")))

  # endpoint distances (km, so coefficients are readable; match however your other dist terms are scaled)
  d$fence_dist             <- terra::extract(fence_dist_r, xy)[, 1] / 1000
  d$ephemeral_rivers_dist  <- terra::extract(eph_dist_r,  xy)[, 1] / 1000
  d$ephemeral_rivers_prox  <- exp(-d$ephemeral_rivers_dist)   # = exp(-d_m / 1000), same as West

  # vector crossings
  cat("fences\n")
  if (!is.null(fences)) {
    d$fence_cross <- cross_vec(d, fences)
  } else {
    fc <- cross_rast(d, fence_r)
    d$fence_cross_any <- fc$any
    d$fence_cross     <- fc$strict   # model uses strict; compare counts with _any and _r500 at checkpoint 3
  }
  cat("perennial\n"); d$river_cross     <- cross_vec(d, perennial)
  cat("ephemeral\n"); d$ephemeral_cross <- cross_vec(d, ephemeral)
  if (!is.null(roads)) {
    d <- d |> rename(any_of(c(road_cross_r500 = "road_cross")))
    cat("roads\n"); d$road_cross <- cross_vec(d, roads)
  }

  stopifnot(!anyNA(d$fence_dist), !anyNA(d$ephemeral_rivers_dist))
  saveRDS(d, here("outputs", sprintf("ele_trk_extract_kaza_%s_v2.rds", s)))
  rm(d); gc()
}
```

## Checkpoint 3: crossing counts and collinearity

```{r check-cross}
cross_summary <- map_dfr(names(STEP_FILES), function(s) {
  d <- readRDS(here("outputs", sprintf("ele_trk_extract_kaza_%s_v2.rds", s)))
  out <- d |>
    select(case_, any_of(c("fence_cross", "fence_cross_any", "fence_cross_r500","river_cross", "river_cross_r500",
                           "ephemeral_cross", "road_cross"))) |>
    pivot_longer(-case_, names_to = "term", values_to = "x") |>
    group_by(term, case_) |> summarise(n_cross = sum(x, na.rm = TRUE), rate = mean(x, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") |>
    pivot_wider(names_from = case_, values_from = c(n_cross, rate), names_glue = "{.value}_{ifelse(case_ == 1, 'used', 'random')}") |>
    mutate(season = s, ratio_used_random = rate_used / rate_random)
  rm(d); gc(); out
})
cross_summary |> arrange(term, season) |> print(n = Inf)
```

How to read it: `ratio_used_random` near 1 means no barrier, well below 1 means a barrier. Vector counts should be **lower** than the `_r500` versions (the raster counted near-misses). Any term with fewer than `MIN_USED_CROSS` used crossings in a season gets dropped from that season's model below.

```{r check-cor}
d <- readRDS(here("outputs", "ele_trk_extract_kaza_dry_v2.rds")) |> slice_sample(n = 200000)
cand <- intersect(c("ephemeral_rivers_dist", "ephemeral_rivers_prox", "ephemeral_cross", "water_rivers_dist",
                    "river_cross", "road_cross", "road_dist", "fence_dist", "fence_cross"), names(d))
cm <- cor(d[, cand], use = "pairwise.complete.obs")
print(round(cm, 2))
flag <- which(abs(cm) > 0.6 & upper.tri(cm), arr.ind = TRUE)
if (nrow(flag)) { cat("\n|r| > 0.6:\n"); print(tibble(a = rownames(cm)[flag[, 1]], b = colnames(cm)[flag[, 2]], r = cm[flag])) }
rm(d); gc()
```

(`ephemeral_rivers_dist` and `_prox` will correlate with each other. That's fine, since they're never in the same model.)

## Fit models

**Match `hab_terms` to the KAZA main model in `kaza_ssf_linear_features.Rmd`.** This is my reading of your last output.

```{r fit}
hab_terms  <- c("elevation", "slope", "aspect", "evi", "world_pop", "tree_cover", "shrubland",
                "grassland", "water_rivers_dist", "cropland_dist", "urban_dist")
dist_terms <- c("road_dist", "fence_dist")

fit_one <- function(terms, d) {
  f <- reformulate(c(terms, sprintf("strata(%s)", STRATA_COL)), response = "case_")
  clogit(f, data = d, model = FALSE)
}

tidy_ci <- function(m) {
  s <- summary(m)$coefficients; ci <- confint(m)
  tibble(term = rownames(s), coef = s[, "coef"], se = s[, "se(coef)"],
         exp_coef = exp(s[, "coef"]), lo95 = exp(ci[, 1]), hi95 = exp(ci[, 2]), p = s[, "Pr(>|z|)"])
}

results <- list()
for (s in names(STEP_FILES)) {
  cat("\n== fitting", s, "==\n")
  d <- readRDS(here("outputs", sprintf("ele_trk_extract_kaza_%s_v2.rds", s)))

  # which crossing terms have enough data this season
  cs <- cross_summary |> filter(season == s)
  enough <- function(t) isTRUE(cs$n_cross_used[cs$term == t] >= MIN_USED_CROSS)
  cross_terms <- c("road_cross", "river_cross", if (enough("fence_cross")) "fence_cross")
  cat("Crossing terms used:", paste(cross_terms, collapse = ", "), "\n")
  if (!enough("ephemeral_cross")) warning("Too few ephemeral crossings in ", s)

  base <- c(hab_terms, dist_terms, cross_terms)
  specs <- list(
    `1. base (new fences, vector crossings)` = base,
    `2. + eph dist`                          = c(base, "ephemeral_rivers_dist"),
    `3. + eph prox`                          = c(base, "ephemeral_rivers_prox"),
    `4. + eph dist + eph cross`              = c(base, "ephemeral_rivers_dist", "ephemeral_cross"),
    `5. + eph prox + eph cross`              = c(base, "ephemeral_rivers_prox", "ephemeral_cross")
  )
  fits <- map(specs, fit_one, d = d)

  aic_tab <- tibble(season = s, model = names(fits),
                    AIC = map_dbl(fits, AIC), BIC = map_dbl(fits, BIC)) |>
    mutate(dAIC = AIC - min(AIC), dBIC = BIC - min(BIC))

  # step-length check on the best ephemeral model
  best_eph <- aic_tab |> filter(model != names(specs)[1]) |> slice_min(AIC) |> pull(model)
  m_sl  <- fit_one(c(specs[[best_eph]], "sl_m", "log_sl_m"), d)
  shift <- tidy_ci(fits[[best_eph]]) |> select(term, coef, se) |>
    inner_join(tidy_ci(m_sl) |> select(term, coef_sl = coef), by = "term") |>
    mutate(season = s, shift_move_se = (coef_sl - coef) / se)

  results[[s]] <- list(aic = aic_tab,
                       coefs = imap_dfr(fits, ~ tidy_ci(.x) |> mutate(model = .y, season = s)),
                       shift = shift, best_eph = best_eph)
  rm(d, fits, m_sl); gc()
}
saveRDS(results, here("outputs", "kaza_ssf_v2_results.rds"))
```

## Results

```{r results}
aic_all <- map_dfr(results, "aic"); print(aic_all)

# the terms the team asked about
map_dfr(results, "coefs") |>
  filter(str_detect(term, "ephemeral|fence|river_cross|road_cross")) |>
  arrange(season, model, term) |> print(n = Inf)

# step-length robustness: |shift| < 2 SE = robust
map_dfr(results, "shift") |> filter(str_detect(term, "cross|ephemeral")) |> print(n = Inf)

# do the habitat coefficients move when ephemeral terms are added? (base vs best)
map_dfr(names(results), function(s) {
  cf <- results[[s]]$coefs
  inner_join(cf |> filter(model == "1. base (new fences, vector crossings)") |> select(term, coef, se),
             cf |> filter(model == results[[s]]$best_eph) |> select(term, coef_eph = coef), by = "term") |>
    mutate(season = s, shift_se = (coef_eph - coef) / se)
}) |> filter(term %in% hab_terms) |> arrange(desc(abs(shift_se))) |> print()
```
```{r}
  for (s in names(STEP_FILES)) {
    d <- readRDS(here("outputs", sprintf("ele_trk_extract_kaza_%s_v2.rds", s)))
    terms <- c(hab_terms, dist_terms, "road_cross", "river_cross", "fence_cross",
               "ephemeral_rivers_prox", "ephemeral_cross")
    m <- fit_one(terms, d)
    m$residuals <- m$linear.predictors <- NULL   # drop the 4M-length vectors; coefs and vcov stay
    saveRDS(m, here("outputs", sprintf("kaza_ssf_v2_model5_%s.rds", s)))
    rm(d, m); gc()
  }
```


**Reading it for the team:**

- **"No proximity effect"** = the dist/prox coefficient has a small effect size and a tight CI. With ~400k strata a tiny effect can still be "significant," so report the size, not just p.
- **"Not a barrier"** = exp(coef) for `ephemeral_cross` with a 95% CI close to 1 (e.g. 0.9–1.1). A wide CI is "can't tell," not "no barrier."
- **dist vs prox:** compare models 2 vs 3 (and 4 vs 5). If prox wins or ties, use prox so all three populations match West.
- **Old vs new AIC:** only compare models fit to the same rows. These use the same KAZA steps as before, so they're comparable to your earlier KAZA fits, but not to Etosha or West.
